articles.title: High oil prices and subsidies rev up European EV sales
articles.description: Electric vehicle sales accelerated across much of Europe in July, as high oil prices, subsidies and availability of more affordable models encouraged consumers to ditch their combustion-engine cars, data provided to Reuters showed.

articles.title: Rain Industries share price: Petrochemical stock jumps 4% amid soaring crude oil prices on US-Iran war
articles.description: Rain Industries share price rose over 4% on 24 August, driven by rising crude oil prices amid US-Iran tensions. Q2CY26 revenue reached ₹5,167 crore, exceeding forecasts, with significant growth in Carbon and Advanced Materials segments, while Cement performance lagged behind.

articles.title: Asian shares mostly decline as bond market pressure mounts
articles.description: Asian shares are mostly lower and oil prices have declined at the start of a week capped by a meeting of top U.S. economic officials at Jackson Hole. U.S. futures edged lower. South Korea's Kospi lost 3.5% early Monday and the Hang Seng in Hong Kong fell more than 2%. On Friday, U.S. stocks rose, trimming their losses from a shaky week. The bond market remains jumpy, pressuring stock prices. The S&P 500 rose 0.4% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 1%. The Nasdaq composite climbed 0.4%. A report suggesting strong growth in U.S. business activity raised hopes for broad corporate profits.
